card.name: Words just before a possible plug or plugin
card.fires_on: Short linking words like the, simply, an and inappropriate in web text, where a word such as plug or plugin could plausibly come next. It also fires on the start 'pl' in words like platter, plazomicin and arthroplasty.

modes.label: Linking words in web text
modes.description: Small words such as the, simply or an in instructions or site notices, where the next word could be plug, plugin or ad-related.

modes.label: Start of pl- words
modes.description: The letters 'pl' that begin a longer word, such as platter or plazomicin.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward plug and plugin words and away from word pieces starting with 'ug'.
card.plain: It lights up on small words where a word like plug or plugin might come next, and on the letters pl- that start longer words.
